in_marathi.name: Arindom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arindom हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arindom is a Sanskrit name composed of 'ari' (strong, powerful) and 'dhum' (pleasing, delightful). This name was borne by Arindam Vidya Sagar, a renowned Indian scholar and polymath.

in_bengali.name: Arindom
